diagnosis: The lone decision-maker passed checks C3 and C4 because the rollout settlements included the factual basis 'S4', which states 'The safety walkdown changes the placement to at least 25 meters, adds the bonded grounding kit, and requires Morgan to document those specific controls in the outage permit.' This fact was accessible to the decision-maker, even though PF2, which contains this information, was not directly owned by the decision-maker. Checks C5 also passed due to the same reason, as 'S4' was revealed in the justified facts.
